commonProcedure.authority: KEEP every native card, original question, Core row and class-access row copied in this procedure. This is proposed static manuscript authorship for the named spell only. No whole-source promotion, runtime selection, canonical mutation, campaign fact, CR certification or closure follows. Original catalog fields remain byte-exact in the source packet.
commonProcedure.casting: KEEP actual source-class rank9, minimum class level17 and base26RP, Action, range120feet and V/S/F. Check actual learned/prepared repertoire, current class school, source conditions, speech, free somatic hand and held focus, perception/LoE, range and whole-body fit before payment. Declare the exact body spaces, facing and profile; no after-roll search. Commit actual Action/RP, Dissonance/Refrain and concentration before interruption. No refunds on counter, intervening invalidity or failed formation. Wizard first distinct family removes only base strain; repeats retain ordinary base plus Refrain and actual pre-cast surcharge. No upcast benefit is authored. Class techniques with similar names remain separate sources.
commonProcedure.formation: NEW generated profiles occupy real boxes, support their own weight plus admitted cargo and cannot overlap occupants/solid matter. Range and LoE are checked to each declared whole-body anchor; support and clearance apply to the entire body. Known-invalid declarations spend nothing. Paid newly-invalid formation fails atomically with no substitute. Generated identity, source owner, current controller, original class, body, root source and parent source remain distinct. Creation is local magical formation, not a traveler crossing a portal. Exact actual creation/ward predicates still apply; this creates no generic planar bypass. Ordinary ranges and movement use the accepted equal orthogonal/diagonal5ft grid metric (COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST); explicitly selected cone/sphere/body-intersection templates retain their stated exact three-dimensional geometry.
commonProcedure.command: KEEP one owner-wide command and one offensive-companion allowance per numbered round, including other families, except the exact Army/Decay cohorts explicitly selected below. NEW audible Common command, owner perception and LoE, same plane and within60ft to the commanded body at issuance and execution. Issue with a genuine Bonus Action during the controller's actual regular turn; an unspent wallet outside that turn is insufficient. The owner's whole turn ends before the original-source-owner attached phase. A new body may execute in that upcoming phase of its creation round if legally commanded; no free creation attack. One declared movement budget can precede/between permitted strike components; no hidden retarget. An impossible, suppressed, out-of-range, dead, budget-starved or expired order fails without refund and is cleared at its designated phase. Never bank/replay. Replacement overwrites an unexecuted order only through a newly legal paid command; it cannot restore an already spent shared allowance. Uncommanded capable generated bodies only reposition defensively within Speed and Dodge at their existing attached phase. They have no independent initiative, generic Reaction, spell list, resource pool, tactical stance or autonomous offense.
commonProcedure.clocks: KEEP actual regular source markers every6seconds, typed starts/ends, independent actors' original phases and numbered-round caps. Attached resolution is not a new regular turn and refreshes no caster Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, recharge or death save. New orders identify exactly one future attached opportunity. Extra Action/turn, reorder, transfer, recast, suppression and resumption do not refill existing round allowances. Body recharge uses original regular owner starts, not pulses. Dead/absent original owners retain virtual markers for source clocks. The Wyrm's uncommanded defensive phase survives caster absence while its nonconcentration source exists.
commonProcedure.damage: NEW each attack has a separate immutable root; one breath has one root with independent recipient packets; each aura has one root per body/source/recipient/actual regular-start marker. Actual acting body is dealer, original source owner supplies only authorized stats. Controller Null Veil does not convert a companion root. Snapshot actual dealer Null status at root creation; transfers preserve it, new reflected roots evaluate their dealer. No owner lifesteal, kill-resource, Dissonance vent, XP, corpse fuel or recursive proc follows companion damage. Attacks use ordinary hit/critical rules; saves are binary. Resolve cover, immunity, one applicable resistance, tempHP, HP and actual lifecycle once per packet. Every target keeps its own allowances, concentration, defense roots and conditions. Resistances are type-specific halves rounded down, never immunity or healing.
commonProcedure.aura: NEW Avatar and Decay auras operate on every other creature, including allies/caster, with any body volume within10ft of the source body and actual line of effect from the nearest body surface. No hostility oracle. Each recipient's first future regular START while inside resolves one pulse; ordinary entry does not pulse, attached companion phases and extra turns do not pulse. Companions use their original owner's regular source marker for this passive check only. Outside initiative use a distinct recipient source-relative6second exposure clock established on first exposure; entering initiative preserves that next due marker rather than adding an immediate tick. Same spell family resolves only the greatest rolled unsuppressed pool at a shared recipient marker; tie earlier application then sourceID. All losing roots consume their due opportunity, with no later replay. Different families remain separate actual packets. Roll one2d6 per source/recipient marker; DEX save for Elemental fire, CON for Decay necrotic, success half. No damage to objects, plants as scenery, terrain, items or real cargo; no disease, corrosion, maximum loss, lasting Burn or ignition. Actual magical suppression clips the local aura intersection without suppressing an outside body. A suppressed/missed pulse is lost.
commonProcedure.stats: KEEP standard missing AC12+floor(original-owner PB/2) at creation; original-owner current PB for saves, original-owner current class attack/DC for explicitly authored attacks/powers. NEW anatomy/ability/carrying fields are enumerated in BODY_PROFILES.json. Ability checks use the listed actual ability modifier with no unlisted proficiency, superseding the missing-profile+0 default only for these new profiles. No generic extraordinary senses, immunities or anatomy from a name. Native baseHP remains180 or250; actual creating Wizard Conjuration adds its class level exactly once at creation. Eligible actual Flesh Ascendant applies dynamically only to Undead currently controlled by its acquired owner. Capacity changes never heal, shrinking clamps once without damage; no card/engine duplicate. Profile element/type is fixed for that identity; control changes do not change original stats.
commonProcedure.healingAndZero: KEEP finite-summon HP-only lifecycle: ordinary damage reaching0 ends that body immediately, without Wounds/death saves/corpse/loot. Qualifying Null damage instead retains the same occupying body NullDisabled0 while its source remains; no Actions, movement, commands, aura or attacks. This uses the existing finite-summon recipient branch, not a new global Null rule. No general living-ally healing extension is selected. These generated Elementals/Undead are not certified living allies for Healing Rite, AC4 water-pet or AC6 named-profile healing; their actual target predicate fails before activation. No repair source is invented. A future explicitly eligible source may restore positive HP under its own rule, preserving identity/deadline/used history, but that is held content, not demonstrated recovery. Independent expiry/dismissal/replacement/source removal still ends Disabled bodies.
commonProcedure.suppression: NEW named bridge SH202-SUPPRESS applies only to the four generated profiles here: any body-volume intersection with a genuine whole-body magical suppression makes that same occupying body inert and suppresses source-provided movement/actions/attacks/traits/commands while retaining HP, identity, mass, cargo and original clock. Partial-body intersection affects the entire body; area-only/rider suppression clips only that expression. Whole-parent suppression pauses all its existing bodies; local one-body suppression does not pause other Army units. Regaining expression restores only legal unspent capabilities, never HP, past orders, pulses or turns. Source deadlines continue. Body occupies/supports physically; losing genuinely magical support starts actual Falling, with no teleport to ground. Antimagic Field149 is invoked only through its exact current accepted area/origin/removal semantics and an acquired actor. No fictional Greater Dispel.
commonProcedure.removalAndProperty: NEW generated parent is one rank9 ongoing source with individually addressable body expressions. A legal single-effect dispel aimed at one body ends that body only; targeting the perceptible parent casting anchor ends every remaining body. Single-body spells have the same body/parent ending. NEW parent locus is caster's fixed formation point, with a faint visible rune that reveals no hidden spell/owner metadata; a perceived body is also a legal expression target. Real Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3, Action3RP/range60/recharge2, INT+PB vs19, not a rank5 substitute. Capture legality/suppression before removal. Counterspell is cast-time only. At actual ending, intrinsic anatomy/gear vanishes; real property retains its recorded actual world position when the generated body ends; apply actual support and Falling without relocation. No new nearest-space teleport or generic terminal Pending-placement privilege is selected. Existing source-qualified Pending records remain unchanged. If a necessary physical support/placement fact is unavailable, retain the entire affected branch as a physical hold with property conserved; do not fabricate an empty square or an obstruction. Real riders/cargo never teleport/vanish with a generated body. Unsupported real bodies/items follow actual support/Falling; keep custody, mass, Load, claims and clocks. No terminal transport/return, resurrection, harvesting or manufactured loot is granted. Existing Transport6 terminal settlements are used only for their own exact sources. Carried property retains its actual recorded attachment offset during carrier movement; a separate relocation requires its own legal action.

spellLocalProcedure.rot: NEW passive10ft2d6 necrotic aura, CON save half, every other creature including Undead, allies and caster. Actual necrotic resistance/immunity applies. This does not heal Undead or imply disease, object decay, corrosion, poison, maximumHP loss, harvest or corpse creation. It uses independent body-root/recipient-start timing in the common aura contract and costs no command.
spellLocalProcedure.admission: NEW while live/operative, the avatar can relay one paid owner order to every actually perceived Undead creature in60ft, same plane, with LoE and an understood audible Common instruction; no CR/count/ownership/faction cap. Other languages require actual shared communication, not a universal telepathic translator. Corpses, missing/unknown type or generated Elementals do not qualify. Own/allied/opposed independently owned creatures are considered individually. NEW mental-compulsion spell component, not Charmed or a generic physical restraint; actual Mind Blank Abjuration prevents a fresh relation before guard spend, suppresses an existing covered expression. No invented save, belief rewrite, allegiance, memory access, free resource use or self-harm order.
spellLocalProcedure.commandChain: NEW SH202-DECAY-RELAY: caster pays one genuine BA and owner-wide command/control-offense entitlement in their regular turn. Their avatar relays the enumerated orders in its original attached phase, within its live source and legal communication. Every recipient gets one specific next-future existing regular Action or original-owner attached opportunity; passed slots wait for next regular one within the parent deadline. This is an explicit multi-recipient exception to the caster's single-companion scope, not extra creature turns or actions. No arbitrary wallet outside a phase. Existing companions retain original owners' structural one-offense limits: reserve each actual owner/round independently for the named target; if already spent/claimed, that target cannot execute and its order expires. Never charge an unwilling original owner a BA. Other independent owners' allowances are separate, not one global pool. Intrinsic caps, source uses, original stats and current resources remain.
spellLocalProcedure.guardAndConflict: NEW nonconsensual replacement of an actual Action/movement is hard control and uses the existing source-character(the ultimate caster)/target/encounter guard across all that character's sources, never a new guard per avatar. Prevented/illegal/unexecuted command spends no guard; execution spends it once. Later commands from that caster cannot force that target again and receive no invented soft fallback. Freely cooperating targets may voluntarily comply using their own legal agency; that is not permission to declare an unwilling target cooperative. Existing hard-control immunity is respected. Competing force orders preserve both histories and resolve earlier valid reservation first; later cannot replace a completed slot. No universal newest-control rule. PC retains actual target/route choice and source restrictions; no compelled expenditure, self-harm, item transfer or secret disclosure. Requested ordinary attack, Dodge or safe movement must be lawful. Structural source-owner caps can make a particular target unavailable without suppressing unrelated owners.
spellLocalProcedure.relationEnding: NEW each single-order control relation ends immediately after its one designated execution, restoring original controller without healing or a fresh opportunity. An unexecuted order expires at its exact single designated opportunity, on actual source loss, control/body suppression, loss of type/reach/communication/LoE/plane or invalidity; clear reservations immediately, retaining costs/spent guards. Parent expiry/dismissal/ordinary zero ends every created relation; NullDisabled0 makes avatar incapable and cancels orders while retaining its body. Rider-only suppression cancels only the affected relay. Agency restores prospectively with original owner, effects, HP, resources, schedule and already-spent history. Never resurrect, resummon, grant a fresh Action or replay old order. A new avatar/caster must pass actual shared guards and identity-specific source rules; prior ownership/claims are not deleted.
